text.tspan: G8 publish runs only for main / v* tags — never for pull requests

svg.text: git push feature branch, open PR → main
logs + SARIF findings on the PR
exit 1 → G6 FAIL (report uploaded as artifact)
exit 0 → G6 PASS + JSON report + CycloneDX SBOM
run ci.yml (push) — G1…G7 again on the merge commit
docker push of the image that was scanned (no rebuild)
cosign sign + cosign attest SBOM (keyless, GitHub OIDC)
signed, scanned image ready to deploy (by digest)
